title: 第2035章 杜菲凌之怒第2034章 陷害
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “我同意！”
听到这道声音。
杜菲凌和吕冰几乎同时开口，“闭嘴！”
苍兀老祖：“……”
好好好。
他手里还有一张王炸。
本来他只是试探一下吕冰，没想到吕冰对杨坚这么恨。
吕冰的战力无双。
他巴不得杜菲凌和吕冰之间的关系破裂呢。
即使吕冰没有背叛人族，但让杜菲凌对吕冰排斥，也算此番的收获了。
“没想到在棋局之外，竟然有收获。”
苍兀老祖心里总算好受了一些。
这也算是意外之喜。
吕冰盯着杜菲凌，“小杜杜，你听我解释。我真的很想去空间通道，但是这苍兀老祖就是一个狗皮膏药啊！”
杜菲凌目光如寒山，“还在嘴硬。”
苍兀老祖适时的拱火道，“原来这一次是考验吕冰啊，杜菲凌你可算考验对了。我想，你对此物一定很感兴趣。”
他拂袖一挥。
一个黑色水晶球向着杜菲凌飞了过去。
吕冰一看，直接慌了，他祭出冰戟，身上冰寒之力澎湃涌动，大吼道，“小杜杜，当务之急，是你我联手，灭了苍兀这个老东西。”
他的手中，冰戟直接一扫，冰寒之力化作长河。
他想要将黑色水晶球斩碎！
一条冰龙直接咆哮了起来。
但杜菲凌的玉手一探。
她的玉手轻飘飘的直接越过了冰戟，将黑色水晶球抓了过来。
“什么东西？”
她犹豫了一下，还是将神念探入。
“不要！不要看啊啊！”
吕冰大声吼道，但是却为时已晚。
苍兀老祖露出了得逞的笑容，“好戏开场了。”
很快，杜菲凌看到了吕冰和苍兀老祖的交易。
她的嘴唇在颤抖！
吕冰直接慌了。
最担心的事情发生了！
“这都是假的！”
“是苍兀这个狗东西想要陷害我！”
吕冰看着杜菲凌的绝美面容越来越冰冷，他连忙大叫着解释了起来。
“我哪里陷害你了，你是自己想要赌一把。”
苍兀老祖桀桀冷笑。
杜菲凌的美眸中出现了杀意，“我对你太失望了！”
content_en:
"I agree!"
Hear this voice.
Du Feiling and Lu Bing said almost at the same time, "Shut up!"
Ancestor Cangwu: "..."
OK OK.
He also has a king bomb in his hand.
Originally, he was just testing Lu Bing, but he didn't expect Lu Bing to hate Yang Jian so much.
Lu Bing's combat prowess is unparalleled.
He wished that the relationship between Du Feiling and Lu Bing broke down.
Even if Lu Bing did not betray the human race, having Du Feiling reject Lu Bing was still a gain.
“I didn’t expect that there would be gains outside of the chess game.”
Ancestor Cangwu finally felt better.
This can be considered an unexpected surprise.
Lu Bing stared at Du Feiling, "Little Dudu, listen to my explanation. I really want to go to the space channel, but this Cangwu ancestor is just a dog-skin plaster!"
Du Feiling's eyes were as cold as a mountain, "Still speaking harshly."
Ancestor Cangwu said to the fire at the right time, "It turns out that this time is to test Lu Bing, and Du Feiling, you are right. I think you must be very interested in this thing."
He waved his sleeves.
"Chi!"
A black crystal ball flew towards Du Feiling.
When Lu Bing saw it, he immediately panicked. He pulled out his ice halberd, and with the cold power surging around his body, he shouted, "Little Dudu, the top priority is that you and I should join forces to destroy this old guy Cang Wu."
In his hand, the ice halberd was swept away, and the cold power turned into a long river.
He wants to chop the black crystal ball into pieces!
An ice dragon roared directly.
"Roar!"
But Du Feiling's delicate hand took a look.
"Chi!"
Her jade hand flew directly over the ice halberd and grabbed the black crystal ball.
"What?"
She hesitated for a moment, but still put her spiritual thoughts into it.
"No! Don't look!"
Lu Bing shouted loudly, but it was too late.
Ancestor Cangwu showed a smile of success, "The show has begun."
Soon, Du Feiling saw the deal between Lu Bing and Patriarch Cangwu.
Her lips are trembling!
Lu Bing immediately panicked.
The thing you were most worried about happened!
"This is all fake!"
"It's this bitch Cang Wu who wants to frame me!"
Lu Bing looked at Du Feiling's beautiful face getting colder and colder, and he quickly shouted to explain.
"How did I frame you? You just wanted to take a gamble."
Cangwu Patriarch Jie Jie sneered.
Du Feiling's beautiful eyes showed murderous intent, "I'm so disappointed in you!"
